newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Britain says strongly supports U.S. raids on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Britain says strongly supports U.S. raids on Iraq.

text.p: Britain strongly supports U.S. cruise missile attacks launched on Tuesday against targets in Iraq, British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind said.
"We strongly support the action that has been taken by the U.S. against Iraq," Rifkind told a news conference in the Mongolian capital of Ulan Bator, where he is on a visit.
The U.S. military on Tuesday launched cruise missile strikes against air defence targets in Iraq in retaliation for Iraqi military attacks against Kurdish groups, the Pentagon said.
Rifkind said Britain had discussed the strikes with the United States over the last two or three days and vowed further military action by Baghdad would be met with similar strikes.
"Saddam Hussein must learn in a hard way that every time he commits aggression, he loses more than he gains," Rifkind said.
"Any future aggression would inevitably invite a similar response," he said. "We know from the past that the man cannot be trusted."
